notes: Summary: Datavine is a mid-market product analytics platform building a searchable knowledge layer for in-app help and recommendations.
Primary ask: embeddings + semantic search for product docs + session transcripts. Daily batch job to reindex ~2M docs (each doc -> average 4 vectors).

Latency/throughput: want p50 < 120ms for single-vector queries in app (frontend autosuggest), and ability to handle peak concurrent embedding requests ~80 qps. Batch pipeline: nightly job must upsert 500k-1M vectors in a 3-4 hour window.

Current infra: Postgres for metadata, Airflow orchestrates ETL, Pinecone used for vector index. They currently run OpenAI embeddings via serverless functions; looking to shift to Redwood-hosted embeddings to reduce cost and centralize ops.
Model preference: open model embeddings (text-embedding-3-small/medium equivalence) and option to pin a quantized variant on Dedicated. Careful about model drift — want eval hooks.
SE notes: Priya recommended batching size 512 for embeddings and multi-threaded upserts to Pinecone; suggested measuring tokenized input length distribution before POC.

Quote from Head of Product: "We need predictable unit cost and a clear plan for scaling nightly upserts without blowing the bill. If Hosted proves stable, we want a glidepath to Dedicated for guaranteed throughput."

Security: must have SSO (SAML), KMS for key management, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance; legal requested data residency in us-east or us-west and 30-day retention controls on raw inputs.

POC plan: 1) Hosted API small-scale smoke (3 days) — generator + upsert test; 2) Performance run: 500k vectors upsert in < 3 hours and sustained 50-80 qps embedding calls; 3) Demo Dedicated sizing with committed GPUs and predictable latency SLOs.

Risk: Pinecone compatibility for chunked upserts (rate-limits) — RDW-58 logged to track adapter work. If Pinecone throttling appears, we may propose using Redwood-backed vector store proxy or recommend alternate vector DB flows.
Pricing conversation: finance curious about hybrid pricing — hosted unit pricing for initial months then a Dedicated reservation model. Drive deck shared.
